# OfficeIMO OneNote fixture data

This folder recognizes the OfficeIMO project and the Apache Tika maintainers. It contains the five Tika `.one` section samples and the OfficeIMO-generated `.onepkg` sample described below. No OfficeIMO or Tika parser code is copied.

OfficeIMO OneNote fixture source revision: `8e0c7f5d06c8ee7c2658c4e90eaa3c1bcd32d1f1`

The five `.one` files are unchanged from Apache Tika commit `63e22d08ef249cc73a6d02da7bc199fc3623a607`, under Apache-2.0. The Apache license and NOTICE are included here. The corresponding CAB cases generated by OfficeIMO are included too.

The CAB files are copied unchanged from the pinned OfficeIMO fixture set. The two Tika-derived CAB files retain Apache Tika attribution and terms. The seven generated E8 CAB fixtures are covered by OfficeIMO's MIT notice, included as `LICENSE-MIT-OfficeIMO.txt`.

`makecab-lzx-notebook.onepkg` is a small synthetic notebook generated by OfficeIMO and packaged with Windows `makecab`. Its source and hash are recorded in `SHA256SUMS.txt`; it is covered by the OfficeIMO MIT notice. The handwriting `.one` fixture from OfficeIMO's source folder is stored once under `3p/onenote.rs/samples/handwriting_recognition.one` with its MPL-2.0 provenance.

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists hashes for every binary fixture stored in this folder. The complete OfficeIMO source inventory and generation notes are documented in the upstream `OfficeIMO.OneNote.Tests/Fixtures/SOURCE.md` at the pinned revision.

The importer tests the five `.one` files in HTML and CMGFM output modes and checks `.onepkg` detection. The CAB files are preserved for future container coverage; NoteCraft currently does not import standalone `.cab` files. No claim of full OneNote package support is made.
